title: GTA6 Can't Completely Sweep This Year's GOTY Awards Anymore
description: Push Square reports that GTA6 will miss out on the Golden Joysticks awards this year because the ceremony takes place before the game's release.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Misses Out on Golden Joysticks Awards

As the gaming industry heads toward the annual awards season, discussions regarding potential Game of the Year contenders are in full swing. However, according to a recent report by gaming media outlet Push Square, there is one major award that *GTA6* cannot win in 2026: the Console Game of the Year at the Golden Joysticks.

## Why GTA6 Is Absent from the Lineup

The reason behind this exclusion is purely a matter of timing. The Golden Joysticks awards show takes place eight days before *GTA6* is even released. At that point, reviewers will still be experiencing the game, making it impossible to feature in the ceremony's current awards cycle. 

Furthermore, the logistics of the event dictate that nominations had to be submitted by August 28th. Because of this strict deadline, the highly anticipated title could not secure a spot among the initial nominees.

## Looking Ahead at the Awards Season

While missing out on the Golden Joysticks means *GTA6* cannot completely sweep every single accolade this year, such scheduling conflicts are not entirely uncommon in the industry when massive blockbuster titles launch late in the calendar year. Industry context suggests that the game's broader impact on future awards seasons will depend heavily on its release performance and critical reception.

## Editor's Take

Missing out on the Golden Joysticks due to a pre-release awards date is simply a matter of bad timing rather than any reflection on the game itself. Fans looking forward to the title shouldn't read too much into this initial absence, as the wider awards landscape in the future will undoubtedly offer plenty of opportunities for the game to make its mark.
